conceptBreakdown.content:
### 4.1 Respiratory Volumes & Capacities Diagnostic Matrix

| Volume / Capacity | Abbreviation | Normal Adult Value | Definition & Calculation Formula |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tidal Volume** | **TV** | $\approx 500\text{ mL}$ | Air inspired or expired during quiet breathing ($6000\text{--}8000\text{ mL/min}$). |
| **Inspiratory Reserve Volume** | **IRV** | $2500\text{--}3000\text{ mL}$ | Additional maximal air inspired forcibly beyond normal tidal inspiration. |
| **Expiratory Reserve Volume** | **ERV** | $1000\text{--}1100\text{ mL}$ | Additional maximal air expired forcibly beyond normal tidal expiration. |
| **Residual Volume** | **RV** | $1100\text{--}1200\text{ mL}$ | Air remaining in lungs after maximal forced expiration. **Cannot be measured by spirometry!** |
| **Inspiratory Capacity** | **IC** | $3000\text{--}3500\text{ mL}$ | Total air inspired after normal tidal expiration ($\text{IC} = \text{TV} + \text{IRV}$). |
| **Expiratory Capacity** | **EC** | $1500\text{--}1600\text{ mL}$ | Total air expired after normal tidal inspiration ($\text{EC} = \text{TV} + \text{ERV}$). |
| **Functional Residual Capacity** | **FRC** | $2100\text{--}2300\text{ mL}$ | Air remaining in lungs after normal tidal expiration ($\text{FRC} = \text{ERV} + \text{RV}$). **Cannot be measured by spirometry!** |
| **Vital Capacity** | **VC** | $3500\text{--}4500\text{ mL}$ | Maximum air expired after maximal forced inspiration ($\text{VC} = \text{ERV} + \text{TV} + \text{IRV}$). |
| **Total Lung Capacity** | **TLC** | $5700\text{--}6000\text{ mL}$ | Total air in lungs at maximal forced inspiration ($\text{TLC} = \text{VC} + \text{RV}$). **Cannot be measured by spirometry!** |

> [!CAUTION]
> **Spirometry Limit Trap**: Any lung capacity containing Residual Volume (RV)—namely **RV, FRC, and TLC**—CANNOT be directly measured with a spirometer.
